notes.title: GRIT Coming to Early Access on January 25!
notes.notes:
It’s official - GRIT is entering Early Access on Tuesday, January 25!

After years of hard work, we're excited to show off the unique gunslinging gameplay of our Wild West royale.

Every game of GRIT is different - from Train Chase to Golden Horse, you’ll have to stay on your toes to survive in an evolving frontier.

[previewyoutube=qxLUDtS9gTc;full][/previewyoutube]


Plus, with a variety of missions to complete, Logbooks to fill out, and cosmetics to unlock, there's always a reason to keep coming back for more!

January 25th is right around the corner - we've saved you a spot at the table, so we hope you'll pull up a chair and join us for a game. Add GRIT to that wishlist, mark that calendar, dust off that saddle, and get ready to head out West! We'll see you there!

notes.title: GRIT RELEASE MOVED TO EARLY 2022
notes.notes:
Howdy, partners!
 
Last month, we were hard at work in our game forge, hammering away furiously in preparation for our intended Early Access launch — although we did take some occasional breaks to playtest with our friendly and dedicated GRIT community.

While GRIT is a lot of fun to play right now, the past three weeks of playtests and player commentary had us thinking a lot about the game, and how we picture the game’s future.  After a whirlwind of intense discussion, everyone was in agreement that GRIT needs more development time in order for it to truly shine.

So we made a very tough call and decided to move the release of GRIT to early 2022. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40222983/f33fb60d3e380d377f1db6621eb4d0bf3d3c233a.jpg[/img]
	
This extra time gives us a chance to complete all the work we have planned and then some, including comprehensive improvements to animations, player progress tracking, features unique to our game that we’ve been excited about putting into action, and much more — all polished up to glitter like a bar of gold.  

We really want to thank our incredible community for joining our playtests and giving us such invaluable feedback.  You’re the reason why we do what we do, which is making sure GRIT is a fun game that’s worthy of your time when we properly release it on Steam.

For future playtests we will likely take a few weeks to make material improvements and then announce more playtests.  Stay tuned and see you in Sunrise County!

Please make sure to meet up with us on [url=https://discord.gg/FightWithGrit]Discord[/url], because more news is coming soon, and that’s the very first place you’ll hear about it.  We can hardly contain our excitement about the changes we are working on, and we want you to be right there with us as we head into this new frontier.  

Until next time, gunslingers!

notes.title: GRIT Dev Blog #5 - Riding the Train
notes.notes:
Howdy, partner!

We’ve been getting a lot of great feedback from our playtesters, and have just [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/738090/view/4719187892134592619]announced[/url] our next scheduled test.

Want to join the fight? “Request Access” on our Steam Store page for a chance to become a pre-Early-Access playtester!

And if you’re looking for a place to meet up with your gang, or maybe just hang out and shoot the breeze, check out our digital ranch on Discord: https://discord.gg/fightwithgrit

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40222983/cf98bf817e17aa8d422d9ecf8f03c5a5f89c3368.png[/img]

Last time, we talked about horses, and the joy of riding across the open range. But experienced travelers of Sunrise County seek another beast of burden, with a soul forged in iron and a fiery heart. Yep, I reckon it’s time you learn how to catch a train.

[b]The Sunrise County Rail System[/b]

When you open your map (default: M), you will see train tracks that snake through the mountains and towns, as well as icons that represent the trains themselves:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40222983/30ad94a9e89c4358ccea658b94f9f5833c451d15.png[/img]

Knowing their location is one thing, but how does one board the train? Well, you could wait at the station in town for it to show up. But for a more dramatic approach, ride your horse up alongside or behind the train. This will give your horse a massive speed boost, allowing you to keep pace until the next scheduled stop.

No matter how you reach the train, you’ll be boarding by pressing the interact button (default: F) near one of the train cars.

Rumor has it some wild daredevils tried jumping right from their horses onto a moving train. We went looking for 'em, but all we found were their hats. So when you hear the whistle blow, watch your step near the tracks, and don't say we didn't warn you.

[b]Passengers and Conductors[/b]

Once you’ve boarded, you can move freely between the cars by heading to the next car in line, then pressing the interact key to hop across the coupler.

If you head to the back of the train, you will reach the caboose, which offers excellent protection from enemy fire. Head to the front, however, and you will reach the engine cab. From here, you can blow the train whistle, which will temporarily push the train to even faster speeds!

[b]Riding Through the Storm[/b]

But wait, what if the train is heading into the Calamity? Fear not, for the train and the area around it are immune to the Calamity for the majority of the match!

When the safe zone becomes very small, this special aura can no longer protect you. So keep an eye on the map, and plan your route to the final showdown.

[b]The Switch Track[/b]

Speaking of planning routes, you might notice signs like these sitting along the train tracks:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40222983/ef6f33fc4f292877ef84105b2768c1b3ae6d1f31.png[/img]

When you shoot at these signs, they will spin, and the track up ahead will change position, sending the train on a different route to head on over to different areas of the map.

Do you have enough skill to shoot that sign from a moving train, and switch to a new track before it’s too late? It ain’t easy…

[b]All Aboard the Sunrise Express[/b]

Have an urge to get out of town fast? Ignore the Calamity in luxurious comfort? Run a science experiment involving switch tracks and dangerously high speeds?

Then it’s high time to hop a train, and travel across Sunrise County in style!

notes.title: GRIT Dev Blog #4 - Gunslinging with your Gang
notes.notes:
Howdy, partner!

Our third round of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/738090/view/3041595029427352964]playtests[/url] opens up again this Friday and Saturday! But it certainly won’t be the last, so “Request Access” on our Steam Store page for a chance to join the pre-Early-Access playtest community!

If you are already a playtester and want to saddle up with others like you, hop on our Discord server: https://discord.gg/fightwithgrit

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40222983/449c70f73f6bc44af5bc94a8752c9bca26f4e30b.png[/img]

With so many new players fixing to join the fight, we think it’s high time you learn to improve your teamwork in GRIT.


[b]SHARING GEAR AND PERKS[/b]

Whether you land gracefully on a saloon balcony or crash into a barn at the start of a match, your first order of business is getting armed and dangerous. But while you do, keep an eye on the lower left part of your screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40222983/d0d945f751a003deb3c50c7319aeccb6396eff1e.png[/img]

These icons will tell you the level of armor and backpack for each team member, and whether they still got a hat. But that’s not all: as weapons with matching suits are collected, another icon will appear to keep track of Perk progress.

Collect four of the same suit and complete a weapon card flush, and a special gold icon will appear. Savvy teams work quickly to collect matching weapons and enable powerful shared Perks!

But what should you do if you find the perfect pistol to complete a partner’s Perk, or a spot a stabled stallion to share on a sunset ride?

That’s easy! Slap a mark on it!


[b]THE MARKING SYSTEM[/b]

The marking system is highly useful to keep your team communicating and working together. Here are the types of pings available to you and your posse:

[b]WAYPOINT / MAP MARKERS - press the [E] key while viewing the map[/b]

Marking the map to let your partners know about key landmarks, a strategic drop point in a certain town, the location of unclaimed horses, or a good rendezvous point are all great ways to stay coordinated and together as you battle enemy gunslingers and the encroaching Calamity. 


[b]POINTING OUT USEFUL ITEMS AND OBJECTS - press the [E] key while looking around
[/b]
When you discover an item your teammates might need, look straight at it, then mark it by tapping E once. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40222983/52534cd1b5dda102edb1ee1b8e748f66e85f12a5.png[/img]

Once marked, a descriptive icon will appear, and your cowpoke will holler at the rest of your gang to describe what they’ve found. This action is key to help your team collect matching weapon suits and become much more powerful in a firefight. 

Weapons and gear aren’t the only things you can mark. Healing items, horses, mountains, mudholes, rustlers, hustlers — place a mark on whatever strikes your fancy!

[b]ENEMY PINGS - double-tap the [E] key[/b]

Letting your crew know when you’ve spotted enemy gunslingers can help your side get the jump on them and often lead to success. Whether your adversaries are hiding in a certain building in town or taking shots from a position on a high ridge, enemy pings are a handy tool to warn your team of clear and present danger.


[b]THERE'S NO "I" IN GANG 
[/b]
While some desperadoes like to leave their gang out in the cold, clever cowpokes know when it’s time to swallow their pride and work together.

So share that Snake Oil, watch each other’s backs, and you’ll live to see another sunrise in Sunrise County!

notes.title: GRIT Dev Blog #3 - Your Trusty Steed
notes.notes:
Howdy Partner,

With your valued help in the GRIT pre-Early Access playtests, we continue to make major strides, as we work to add improvements and features before we launch into Early Access. For those who haven’t yet, be sure to “Request Access” on our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/738090/GRIT/]Steam Store page[/url], as we are looking to bring many more players into our playtesting community. We’ll be announcing the next playtest soon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40222983/b674758b21084248439b4384ddd9b88d4dd143ac.jpg[/img]


Today, we’re going to talk about horses in GRIT, the trusty steeds that help you become the last gunslinger alive in Sunrise County.  


[b]Mobility[/b]

If you don’t plan on catching a train, horses are the best way to stay mobile in GRIT. They are important not only when engaging enemy riders or running down roving bandits, but also when you need to escape the wrath of the oncoming Calamity.  

It’s not always about being the fastest, though — the slower you ride, the more maneuverability you’ve got. A skilled rider will know when to ride like the storm’s chasing you, and when to slow things down a little. And don’t forget that well-timed jumps with your horse can get over pesky obstacles, like fences and rocks. 


[b]Bonding and Equipment[/b]

Every gunslinger has a sensitive side. If you find an unclaimed horse and mount up, that horse and you will bond, which means that if a dirty rustler tries to steal your steed when you aren’t looking, they’ll have to take the time to break that connection. Your horse will make a ruckus when this happens, so catch that thief red-handed, and give them a taste of your displeasure.

You can store all sorts of useful things in your horse’s pack, so that you and your outlaw gang can stay armed and armored to the teeth away from civilization. And sometimes there aren’t enough horses in town for every member of your posse, so be sure to invite one of your teammates to join you for the ride, so they don’t get left in the dust.


[b]Combat[/b]

Your prancing prairie companion isn’t afraid of a little altercation, as long as you’re in the saddle. Any gun you can fire on foot, you can fire while riding — just don’t expect your aim to be all that accurate when you’re charging at a full gallop.

But if you have to jump down and hit the dirt, the situation changes. Your gunslinging accuracy might improve a bit, but if some low-down bandit shoots your horse when you aren’t in the saddle, it’ll bolt for the hills. Smart cowpokes know how to protect their horses, by hiding them behind a big rock, or perhaps in a barn. But if you can’t find a hiding spot, well, maybe you ought to jump out in front of your faithful friend, and show them the true meaning of GRIT.


[b]Let’s Ride, Partner[/b]

There’s nothing like the sight of a squad of four ace gunslingers astride four proud horses, charging into town, with their pistols, rifles, and shotguns at the ready. So get on out there, mount up, and show them how we ride in Sunrise County!
